hook: I run my business solo. No team. No hires.
caption:
I run my business solo — no team, no hires.

Three systems are already running: Instagram publishing, Telegram workflows, and paid ads through an API. I built all three myself, and they run whether I'm at the desk or not.

This account is the build log. What works, what it cost, and what broke.

Follow if you're building alone.
